tokens.usage: Tertiary text, eyebrow labels, inactive nav and chart axis ticks. Only 3.0:1 on surface and 2.9:1 on paper: the source uses it for captions, so keep it to non-essential labels or 24px+ text; use muted for anything a reader must read.

tokens.name: cat-special
tokens.usage: Special collection: batteries, electronics, bulbs, hazardous waste. Solid fill with white glyph; also the dot, marker and chart colour.

tokens.name: cat-bulky

tokens.usage: Tinted tile and pill background for bulky. cat-bulky text on this fill is 4.45:1, marginally under AA.
